title: shortcut file
description: A shortcut file, in format version 2. The top level here is a .shortcut namespace file's; the global store's shortcuts.json and a project's .shortcuts may also have 'imports'. Every file uses the same entry format, except that 'export' is only allowed in .shortcuts and .shortcuts.local, and 'from' only in the global store's shortcuts.json. Only the last entry in 'args' can set 'rest'; the schema doesn't check that, but shortcut does.

description.description: Description of the namespace. Shown in 'list'.

shortcuts.description: The shortcuts in this namespace, by name.

entry.description: One shortcut. Needs exactly one of 'inline' and 'script'.

script.description: Path to a script. A relative path starts at this file's folder and can't escape it. An absolute path is used as it is.

cwd.description: Where it runs: 'caller', a path relative to this file's folder, an absolute path, or a path starting with ~. Default 'caller'.

icon.description: Freedesktop icon name for a desktop launcher. Default 'utilities-terminal'.

export.description: Made to work outside its project: 'init --global' takes only these from a project, and 'promote' takes them without --force. Only allowed in .shortcuts and .shortcuts.local. Default false.

from.description: Where 'promote' took this entry from: the project's folder and the entry's name there. Only allowed in the global store's shortcuts.json.

name.description: The entry's name in that project.

required.description: Refuse to run when this argument is missing and has no default.

default.description: Value used when the argument is missing.

desc.description: A note for people reading the file. Nothing prints it.

rest.description: Take all remaining arguments. Last entry only.
